Legal

Privacy Policy

Effective 12 September 2026

Don’t Break Fast is designed to work without collecting your personal data.

Data collection

Don’t Break Fast does not collect, transmit, sell or share personal data. The app has no accounts, analytics, advertising or third-party tracking technologies.

Data stored on your device

Your fasting history, active fast, selected plan, notification preferences and other settings are stored locally on your device. A small snapshot is shared locally with the app’s widgets and system extensions through Apple’s App Group technology. This information is not sent to NSSCode.

Apple system services

The app uses Apple system features such as local notifications, widgets, Live Activities, Dynamic Island and Shortcuts. Apple may process information needed to provide those services under Apple’s own terms and privacy policies. Don’t Break Fast does not receive that information from Apple.

Deleting your data

You can delete all fasting history from Settings in the app. Deleting the app removes its locally stored data, subject to your device and backup settings.

Children

The app does not knowingly collect personal data from anyone, including children.

Changes

If the app’s data practices change, this policy and the App Store privacy information will be updated before the change is released.

Contact

Questions about privacy can be sent to dontbreakfast@nsscode.com.
